notes: §1985:XII.2.4 GR10: "text words after replacement are placed in the source program according to the rules for reference format", and "additional spaces may be introduced only between text words where there already exists a space". CopyProcessor#ApplyReplacements splices pseudo-text-2 verbatim into the logical text (no space added or removed: witness 1985-GR-XII_2_4-10, probe p10a). Since kb/Work PB5313 (landed) each word of pseudo-text-2 is laid out where it was written (OriginWriter.AppendLaidOut, OriginSpan.Layout) while it stands at the replaced library word (its origin), and AreaPlacementPass judges whether it begins its RESULTANT line from the token stream and its area at its laid-out place: a paragraph header that pseudo-text-2 puts in area A of a line of its own (p9v) or after the opening delimiter in area A (p9iii) compiles at 85 (witness pb5313-copy-pseudo-text-area-a prints IN Q, IN R).

next.reason: 1985: "text words after replacement are placed in the source program according to the rules for reference format"; 2023: "The resultant text after replacement shall be in logical free-form reference format.". 1985 places replaced words by (fixed) reference format rules, spacing limit for pseudo-text-2 only. 2023 mandates logical free-form and applies the spacing rule to all copied words.
